name: @context-ime/vscode-adapter
description: Report normalized VS Code context to the native ContextIME service.

context-ime.adapter.enabled.description: Report normalized editor context to the local ContextIME service.

context-ime.adapter.debounceMs.description: Coalesce rapid VS Code context events before reporting.

context-ime.adapter.heartbeatMs.description: Refresh focused context before the native service's 2-second TTL expires.

context-ime.adapter.timeoutMs.description: Total deadline for one background local Named Pipe report.

context-ime.projectDictionary.enabled.description: Collect bounded symbol names from the active document's Language Server for the local project dictionary.

context-ime.projectDictionary.debounceMs.description: Delay project symbol collection after active-editor, save, or workspace events.

context-ime.projectDictionary.timeoutMs.description: Total deadline for all background Project Indexer batches from one document.

context-ime.projectDictionary.maximumSym.description: Maximum approved Language Server symbols collected from one active document.
